detail.Title: AI-First Engineering Transformation Lead
detail.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Who Are We

Hansen Technologies is a global software and services provider supporting the energy, utilities, water, and telecommunications industries. Our solutions help organisations deliver essential services, introduce new products, engage customers, and manage critical revenue and customer operations across more than 80 countries. 

As AI continues to reshape our industry, we are embedding intelligent capabilities across our products and operations to deliver smarter, faster, and more resilient solutions.
 

 

Why This Role Matters

Transform Engineering. Shape the Future. Build the AI-Native Software Organization.

As our AI-First Engineering Transformation Lead, you'll be responsible for helping Hansen redefine how software is built across our Communications & Media portfolio. Working closely with the Office of the CTO, engineering leaders, architects, and development teams, you'll drive the transition from traditional development practices toward AI-native engineering workflows.

We're looking for someone who combines deep technical credibility with the ability to lead organizational change. You'll operate as a player-coach, working directly with engineering teams while influencing leaders across the organization to adopt new ways of working.

Your impact will be measurable through improved developer productivity, faster delivery cycles, higher software quality, and the successful adoption of AI-powered engineering practices across Hansen.

 

 

What You’ll Do 

Lead Hansen's AI-First Engineering Transformation

  • Shape and drive the shift from traditional SDLC to AI-first, AI-native software engineering.
  • Work hands-on with developers, architects, and engineering leaders to embed tools such as GitHub Copilot Enterprise, Claude Code, and emerging AI platforms into everyday development.
  • Build scalable AI-enabled workflows, reference implementations, and automation patterns that improve how software is designed, built, tested, and delivered.
  • Champion AI adoption across engineering through coaching, playbooks, training, and practical enablement.
  • Establish responsible AI engineering standards across code quality, security, IP protection, compliance, and traceability.
  • Measure and scale impact through clear KPIs including AI adoption, developer productivity, cycle time, and software quality.

 

 

What You Bring

  • Experience implementing AI-first or AI-native engineering models
  • Proven experience leading engineering transformation initiatives at scale
  • Strong software engineering background with hands-on technical credibility
  • Practical experience with AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar platforms
  • Deep understanding of modern engineering practices including Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud-native architectures, and platform engineering
  • Experience driving change, influencing stakeholders, and introducing new engineering ways of working
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage engineers, architects, and executive leadership alike
  • Solid understanding of large language models (LLMs), AI capabilities, and their practical application within software development

 

 

What Makes You Successful

You are someone who:

  • Thrives on transforming how teams build software
  • Leads through action, not PowerPoint
  • Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution
  • Questions existing practices and continuously seeks better ways of working
  • Focuses on outcomes and measurable impact
  • Inspires teams to embrace change rather than resist it
  • Sees AI not as a tool, but as a new operating model for engineering

 

 

Why Join Us?

  • This is a opportunity to help define what AI-first software engineering looks like inside a global technology organization.

  • Rather than joining an established transformation, you'll help build it!

  • If you're excited by the challenge of combining engineering excellence, AI innovation, and large-scale transformation, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Contact Us 

If you possess the desired skills and enthusiasm, please “Apply Now” via the link or visit our career page.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Visit our website at hansencx.com for more information. 

 

 

Data Privacy Notice 

By applying to this role, you consent to Hansen collecting, processing, and storing the information you provide for recruitment purposes. You also agree that your details may be securely retained in our talent database for future opportunities and reference in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.
